title: Mixed Event — Here on Our Dream Stage — Episode6 Feelings Into Songs

meta.Event Outline: The schools of Shibuya are holding the Shibuya City High Schools Joint Festival, a place for students to put on performances. Nene takes on the task of putting on a musical with students from other schools.

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: So, we'll need you all to write these eight songs for this show.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow, they cover all these different genres!

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Yes, one for each musician that's going to appear in this show.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I see...
The songs should feel drastically different from one another, because each musician has their own distinct style.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's why I'd like you to come up with something with a rock feel for Hoshino, pop for Momoi and street for Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Writing songs for all these different genres won't be easy, but it should also be very rewarding.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's do our best to write songs that everyone will enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, Hoshino, are you sure about this? You're already playing a character, and you want to work on writing songs too...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. Given the song count, I feel like Saki and them are going to need help. Also, if possible, I'd like to write the song I'm going to sing.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, thank you again.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: I'm the leader of the songwriting team, so let me know if you ever need any help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, I will.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, let's start deciding which songs we're each going to write.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, can I go first?!
I really wanna write the song for Airi's character!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This melody popped into my head while listening to you guys talk! What do you think?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's very like you, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, since she needs a street song, I'll write the one for Shiraishi.
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Everyone goes about writing songs so differently...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Hoshino and Tenma prefer to use their instruments, while Aoyagi likes to work on his computer.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Some of them start from the chords, some from the melody... Everyone's style is different. I'm having fun just watching them...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I've finished writing a part of the chorus.
Would you mind giving it a quick listen?

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Wait, already?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, but it's still very rough.
I need someone to tell me if it goes with the character's concept.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Okay, I'll give it a listen.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, I wanna listen to it too!
Lemme hear what kind of song you came up with, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Would it be alright if I also listened to it?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Of course. I'd appreciate it if you all gave me your honest opinion. Anyway, I'll play it now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah... You can feel how reserved the protagonist is, and how dreary it is being stuck in her mansion all day. This is incredible...!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. I'm glad to hear that.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I also thought it was really good.
I can already see the protagonist singing this song.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I don't know how to describe it...
But something doesn't feel quite right...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Something doesn't feel right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like something is missing...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Which means my song is failing to capture some key aspect of your character.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Kusanagi, would you mind telling me more about Lulu, the protagonist?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I may be able to figure out what's missing if I know what she's going to feel when she sings this song.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: O-Okay. Umm...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Like Hoshino said just now, Lulu's a very reserved and shy girl, especially due to the fact that she's been stuck in her mansion for so long.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Because of that, she's developed a fascination for the world outside her window. Unfortunately, she's always been too scared to go out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Despite being constantly bored, she spends each day basically doing the same thing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A fascination for the world outside...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, what if I made it sound more like this?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, it's got a totally different feel to it now!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Yeah...! That's incredible.
This suits her a lot more.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Ah, that's good to hear.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Her fascination for the outside world appears to be what was missing.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I tried including more of her curiosity, anticipation and desire to experience new things.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
That's amazing, Toya!
It only took you a second to figure out how Lulu feels and add it to the song!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...! The part you just added is such a beautiful expression of her desire to experience new things... It's crystal clear.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
Then, I'll try expanding on what I have now.

rows.Speaker: Planning Committee Member
rows.Line: Okay, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright!
We can't let Toya hog all the glory! Let's write songs that send shivers down Nene's spine!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Right.
Would you mind telling us a little more about the characters we're working on, Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Sure!
Let's see... Momoi's character is...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wow...! This song's awesome!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You think so?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I agree! I think it's particularly cool how the leadup to the chorus builds up and become more rhythmical!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It's such a wonderful expression of the protagonist's desire for things to change.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really looking forward to hearing An and Kusanagi singing your songs, Aoyagi!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She's off practicing on her own like she usually does, so I'm sure she'll do a good job.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, I heard.
I promise to put everything I have into this song.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, it's good.
This song is a nice expression of who you are, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I think you also did a good job of capturing how the character you told me about feels.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Still, I don't think either of us expected to run into both of you here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?! What are the odds?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. We actually come to this diner fairly often.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I had no idea.
Also, we're sorry for bothering you both when you're trying to relax...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
We like listening to songs that others have made, and I'm really glad we could help.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, then... If you don't mind me asking...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: How would you two go about making improvements to this song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hmm... Well...
I feel that it's good as it is...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I suppose you could make it so the melody stands out a little more.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Right. It's a musical, so it's important to make the lyrics clearly audible.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... Then, I'll see what I can do starting with the pre-chorus or thereabouts...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh...!
Could you two also comment on my song?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Hehe. Sure.
